in_marathi.name: Balak
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balak refers to a child or boy in Hindu mythology. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'balam' which means strength or power. In Hindu scriptures, Balak is an epithet for various deities like Lord Shiva, Lord Vishnu, and Lord Hanuman.
